comment: Single model registry (schema 3). A checkpoint may be loaded or executed ONLY when its status is exactly "admitted", every executable asset has a pinnedSha256 and the entry has a complete admission record (scope internal-evaluation, decision, decidedBy, date, evidence[], checkpointRole, limitations); anything else is demoted at load and refused (fail closed). actualSha256 is an informational observation, never an authority. There is no environment-variable or flag bypass. A model becomes "admitted" only through a reviewed commit that records evidence for the exact checkpoint file. Experiment only: not an approved production model policy. Generated by build_registry.py; history is append-only.

Admitted for internal evaluation ONLY: not for commercial deployment, not for redistribution of weights or cut-outs. Legal questions Q-02 (DIS5K inheritance), Q-06 (re-hosting/conversion terms), Q-10 and Q-12 (outputs) remain unresolved; counsel has not answered them. admission.checkpointRole: rembg-hosted ONNX exports of Meta's sam_vit_b_01ec64 (encoder and decoder, each pinned); the exports are third-party (rembg's hosting), derivation from Meta's .pth is not byte-verifiable
admission.limitations: Apache-2.0 stated by Meta for the model; SA-1B dataset licence text was unreadable (Q-04). The ONNX export maker is not Meta and cannot be verified byte-for-byte against the publisher checkpoint (different format); the admission covers the encoder+decoder PAIR, each pinned. Admitted for internal evaluation ONLY: not for commercial deployment, not for redistribution of weights or cut-outs. Legal questions Q-02 (DIS5K inheritance), Q-06 (re-hosting/conversion terms), Q-10 and Q-12 (outputs) remain unresolved; counsel has not answered them. Decision made by the lead on 2026-11-28 and reversible by the founder (BGD-007).
